title: The imperfect in the plural; the denial withلَا‎

blocks.text: We study, we work, they live in Rome, we don't speak Arabic. With this unity complete the imperfect, adding the plural and the dual, and learn to deny it by ⁧لَا⁩ . You will also see a rule that surprises the Italians: when the verb precedes a plural subject it remains to the singular ( ⁧يَدْرُسُ الطُّلَّابُ⁩ • students study •). Two weeks.

rows: 12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 34–35 of the calendar)

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A1 (tag A1-14), voice synthesis script, tutor session in the second week
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. to unite the imperfect in all thirteen persons;
2. grant the verb with a plural subject before and after the verb;
3. deny the present with ⁧لَا⁩ and respond negatively;
4. use verbs ⁧يَتَكَلَّمُ⁩ , ⁧يَتَعَلَّمُ⁩ , ⁧يُرِيدُ⁩ , ⁧يَقُولُ⁩ , ⁧يَزُورُ⁩ and other frequent verbs;
5. understand a text about a family and a dialogue with negative phrases;
6. tell what you do and what you do not do and your family or your group.
Two-week plan.

blocks.text: Implicit subject . ⁧يَدْرُسُونَ فِي المَكْتَبَةِ⁩ The verb alone contains the subject:

Because. When the verb comes first, the subject that follows already says who acts and how many are: the verb does not repeat it. When the subject has already been said, the verb that follows takes it back with an embedded pronoun (-ūna, - na). In journalistic texts you will find above all the first type: ⁧قَالَ الوُزَرَاءُ⁩ ... "The ministers have said... "with the verb to the singular. The dual works in the same way: ⁧يَعْمَلُ الزَّمِيلَانِ هُنَا⁩ / . ⁧الزَّمِيلَانِ يَعْمَلَانِ هُنَا⁩
